```{r}
strong_up_06h <- 1
weak_up_06h <- 0.5
strong_down_06h <- -1.0
weak_down_06h <- 0.5

strong_up_24h <- 1
weak_up_24h <- 0.5
strong_down_24h <- -1.0
weak_down_24h <- 0.5


# 1. Filter and Build Buckets
df_binned <- anno_operon_stats %>%
  # Filter: keep only genes significant in at least one of these two conditions
  filter(padj_exp < 0.05 | padj_int < 0.05) %>%
  
  # Create the buckets based on LFC and padj at each timepoint
  mutate(
    # --- 06h Buckets ---
    bucket_06h = case_when(
      padj_06h < 0.05 & model_LFC_06h >= strong_up_06h  ~ "Strong_Up",
      padj_06h < 0.05 & model_LFC_06h >= weak_up_06h  ~ "Weak_Up",
      padj_06h < 0.05 & model_LFC_06h <= strong_down_06h ~ "Strong_Down",
      padj_06h < 0.05 & model_LFC_06h <= weak_up_06h ~ "Weak_Down",
      TRUE                                    ~ "No_Change"
    ),
    # --- 24h Buckets ---
    bucket_24h = case_when(
      padj_24h < 0.05 & model_LFC_24h >= strong_up_24h  ~ "Strong_Up",
      padj_24h < 0.05 & model_LFC_24h >= weak_up_24h  ~ "Weak_Up",
      padj_24h < 0.05 & model_LFC_24h <= strong_down_24h ~ "Strong_Down",
      padj_24h < 0.05 & model_LFC_24h <= weak_down_06h ~ "Weak_Down",
      TRUE                                    ~ "No_Change"
    )
  )

# 2. Reshape into a Binary Matrix for the UpSet plot
df_upset <- df_binned %>%
  select(Gene, bucket_06h, bucket_24h) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("bucket_"), names_to = "Timepoint", values_to = "Bucket") %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = str_remove(Timepoint, "bucket_"),
    Set_Name = paste(Timepoint, Bucket, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  # Drop "No_Change" so it doesn't crowd the plot
  filter(Bucket != "No_Change") %>%
  select(Gene, Set_Name) %>%
  mutate(Present = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Set_Name, values_from = Present, values_fill = FALSE)

# Extract the set names for the upset function
all_sets <- colnames(df_upset)[-1]
```

```{r}
library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Cleanly isolate the column names to avoid any indexing offsets
set_columns <- as.character(all_sets)

# 2. Make sure the matrix columns are strictly logical (TRUE/FALSE) 
# as ComplexUpset can act up if they are read as numeric or factors
df_plot_ready[set_columns] <- lapply(df_plot_ready[set_columns], as.logical)

# 3. Generate the clean plot using basic syntax
# Explicitly use the ComplexUpset namespace to prevent conflicts
ComplexUpset::upset(
  data = df_plot_ready,
  intersect = set_columns,
  width_ratio = 0.2,
  min_size = 3,
  wrap = TRUE
) + ggplot2::labs(title = "Regulation Groups")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)

# Make sure you are using your un-split dataset for a clean, error-free base plot
set_columns <- as.character(all_sets)

ComplexUpset::upset(
  data = df_plot_ready,
  intersect = set_columns,
  min_size = 5,
  width_ratio = 0.2,
  wrap = TRUE,
  
  # Queries layer allows you to highlight specific intersection criteria
  queries = list(
    # Highlight intersections containing 06h Strong Up
    ComplexUpset::upset_query(
      set = "06h_Strong_Up",
      color = "firebrick",
      fill = "firebrick"
    ),
    # Highlight intersections containing 24h Strong Up
    ComplexUpset::upset_query(
      set = "24h_Strong_Up",
      color = "darkorange",
      fill = "darkorange"
    )
  )
) + ggplot2::labs(title = "Gene Regulation with Highlighted Strong Up-Regulation")
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# 1. Clean and filter the dataset FIRST before running the app
# Combines your keywords into an "OR" regex pattern (e.g., "term1|term2|term3")
filter_pattern <- paste(housekeeping_terms, collapse = "|")

df_app_filtered <- df_binned %>%
  filter(!across(
    c(Gene, Product, COG_def, KEGG_module_def), 
    ~ str_detect(tolower(as.character(.x)), regex(filter_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) %>% rowSums(na.rm = TRUE) > 0)

# --- UI Layout ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Interactive Gene Exploration: Text Search Highlighting"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      helpText("Instructions:"),
      helpText("1. Type any keyword below to highlight matching genes on the plot."),
      helpText("2. Click and drag a box (brush) on the plot to filter the table further."),
      hr(),
      
      # Text Search Box
      textInput("text_search", "Search Metadata (Case-Insensitive):", value = ""),
      span(textOutput("match_count"), style = "font-weight: bold; color: #2c3e50;"),
      
      hr(),
      selectInput("filter_06h", "Quick Filter 06h Bucket:", 
                  choices = c("All", unique(df_app_filtered$bucket_06h))),
      selectInput("filter_24h", "Quick Filter 24h Bucket:", 
                  choices = c("All", unique(df_app_filtered$bucket_24h)))
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      plotOutput("scatter_plot", brush = brushOpts(id = "plot_brush", resetOnNew = FALSE)),
      br(),
      h4("Selected/Highlighted Genes Functional Annotations"),
      DTOutput("metadata_table")
    )
  )
)

# --- Server Logic ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reactive dataset handling text searching AND dropdown filters
  processed_data <- reactive({
    data <- df_app_filtered
    
    if (input$filter_06h != "All") data <- data %>% filter(bucket_06h == input$filter_06h)
    if (input$filter_24h != "All") data <- data %>% filter(bucket_24h == input$filter_24h)
    
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      search_term <- tolower(input$text_search)
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          is_match = rowSums(across(
            c(Gene, operon, Product, COG, COG_def, COG_cat, KEGG_Module, KEGG_module_def),
            ~ grepl(search_term, tolower(as.character(.x)), fixed = TRUE)
          )) > 0
        )
    } else {
      data <- data %>% mutate(is_match = TRUE)
    }
    data
  })
  
  output$match_count <- renderText({
    df <- processed_data()
    if (!nzchar(input$text_search)) return("")
    match_num <- sum(df$is_match)
    paste0("Found ", match_num, " matching genes.")
  })
  
  # Render the Highlighted Scatter Plot
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = model_LFC_06h, y = model_LFC_24h)) +
      # Threshold dashed lines
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey85") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey85")
    
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      p <- p + 
        geom_point(data = filter(df, !is_match), color = "grey90", alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
        geom_point(data = filter(df, is_match), aes(color = bucket_06h), alpha = 0.9, size = 3) +
        scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    } else {
      p <- p + 
        geom_point(aes(color = bucket_06h), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
        scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    }
    
    p + theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = "Log2 Fold Change Coordinates (Housekeeping Filtered)",
        x = "Log2 Fold Change (06h)",
        y = "Log2 Fold Change (24h)",
        color = "06h Group Structure"
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        # Fixes the primary outer axes to solid bold black lines
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
      )
  })
  
  # Dynamic Interactive Table
  output$metadata_table <- renderDT({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      df <- df %>% filter(is_match)
    }
    
    coords <- input$plot_brush
    if (!is.null(coords)) {
      df <- brushedPoints(df, coords, xvar = "model_LFC_06h", yvar = "model_LFC_24h")
    }
    
    display_df <- df %>%
      select(
        Gene, operon, Product, COG, COG_def, COG_cat, 
        model_LFC_06h, padj_06h, model_LFC_24h, padj_24h,
        KEGG_Module, KEGG_module_def
      )
    
    datatable(
      display_df,
      options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE),
      rownames = FALSE
    )
  })
}

# --- Launch ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
# --- Server Logic ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # 1. Reactive dataset handling text searching AND dropdown filters
  processed_data <- reactive({
    data <- df_binned
    
    # Apply standard bucket filters first
    if (input$filter_06h != "All") data <- data %>% filter(bucket_06h == input$filter_06h)
    if (input$filter_24h != "All") data <- data %>% filter(bucket_24h == input$filter_24h)
    
    # Apply text searching across ALL key metadata columns simultaneously
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      search_term <- tolower(input$text_search)
      
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          is_match = rowSums(across(
            c(Gene, operon, Product, COG, COG_def, COG_cat, KEGG_Module, KEGG_module_def),
            ~ grepl(search_term, tolower(as.character(.x)), fixed = TRUE)
          )) > 0
        )
    } else {
      # If nothing is searched, default everything to a match (normal coloring)
      data <- data %>% mutate(is_match = TRUE)
    }
    
    data
  })
  
  # Text indicator for how many genes match the search term
  output$match_count <- renderText({
    df <- processed_data()
    if (!nzchar(input$text_search)) return("")
    match_num <- sum(df$is_match)
    paste0("Found ", match_num, " matching genes.")
  })
  
  # 2. Render the Highlighted Scatter Plot
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    # Base plot structure
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = model_LFC_06h, y = model_LFC_24h)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80")
    
    # Plotting logic depends on whether user is searching
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      p <- p + 
        # Background: Non-matching genes faded out completely
        geom_point(data = filter(df, !is_match), color = "grey85", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
        # Foreground: Matching genes colored brightly
        geom_point(data = filter(df, is_match), aes(color = bucket_06h), alpha = 0.9, size = 3) +
        scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    } else {
      # Default view when no text is being searched
      p <- p + 
        geom_point(aes(color = bucket_06h), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
        scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    }
    
    p + theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = "Log2 Fold Change Coordinates",
        x = "Log2 Fold Change (06h)",
        y = "Log2 Fold Change (24h)",
        color = "06h Group Structure"
      ) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  })
  
  # 3. Dynamic Interactive Table
  output$metadata_table <- renderDT({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    # If a text search is active, the table immediately narrows down to just matches
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      df <- df %>% filter(is_match)
    }
    
    # If a click-and-drag box is drawn, subset the rows further by plot coordinates
    coords <- input$plot_brush
    if (!is.null(coords)) {
      df <- brushedPoints(df, coords, xvar = "model_LFC_06h", yvar = "model_LFC_24h")
    }
    
    display_df <- df %>%
      select(
        Gene, operon, Product, COG, COG_def, COG_cat, 
        model_LFC_06h, padj_06h, model_LFC_24h, padj_24h,
        KEGG_Module, KEGG_module_def
      )
    
    datatable(
      display_df,
      options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE),
      rownames = FALSE
    )
  })
}

# --- Launch ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
mahal_anno <- left_join(df_final_clusters, anno_operon_stats)


# Your vector of terms
housekeeping_terms <- c(
  "\\b5s\\b", "\\b16s\\b", "\\b23s\\b",
  "rrna",
  "ribosomal protein",
  "^ribosomal large subunit$",
  "^ribosomal small subunit$",
  "sigma factor", "rna polymerase"
)

# 1. Combine terms into a single regex pattern separated by '|'
# We use case-insensitive matching (?i) just in case
pattern <- paste0("(?i)", paste(housekeeping_terms, collapse = "|"))

# 2. Filter out any rows where the pattern matches in ANY column
# Filter rows based on all columns, then completely drop the GO_bak column
filtered_mahal_anno <- mahal_anno %>%
  filter(!if_any(everything(), ~ coalesce(str_detect(as.character(.x), pattern), FALSE))) %>%
  select(-GO_bak) %>%
  mutate(KEGG_Pathway = map_chr(str_split(KEGG_Pathway, ",\\s*"), function(x) {
    # Drop elements starting with "ko" or "KO"
    filtered <- x[!str_detect(x, "(?i)^ko")]
    
    # Re-assemble the remaining pieces back into a single string
    paste(filtered, collapse = ", ")
  }))

head(filtered_mahal_anno)
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

# --- UI Layout ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Interactive Gene Exploration: Cluster Analysis & Text Search"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      helpText("Instructions:"),
      helpText("1. Type any keyword below (e.g., 'transporter', 'operon') to highlight matching genes on the plot."),
      helpText("2. Click and drag a box (brush) on the plot to filter the table below to just those specific points."),

      # Text Search Box
      textInput("text_search", "Search Metadata (Case-Insensitive):", value = ""),
      span(textOutput("match_count"), style = "font-weight: bold; color: #2c3e50;"),
      
      hr(),
      # Quick filter by cluster selection dropdown
      selectInput("filter_cluster", "Quick Filter by Cluster:", 
                  choices = c("All", sort(unique(as.character(filtered_mahal_anno$cluster)))))
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      plotOutput("scatter_plot", brush = brushOpts(id = "plot_brush", resetOnNew = FALSE)),
      br(),
      h4("Selected/Highlighted Genes Functional Annotations"),
      DTOutput("metadata_table")
    )
  )
)

# --- Server Logic ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # 1. Reactive dataset handling text searching AND cluster filters
  processed_data <- reactive({
    data <- filtered_mahal_anno
    
    # Apply standard cluster dropdown filter first
    if (input$filter_cluster != "All") {
      data <- data %>% filter(cluster == input$filter_cluster)
    }
    
    # Apply text searching across ALL key metadata columns simultaneously
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      search_term <- tolower(input$text_search)
      
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          is_match = rowSums(across(
            # Adjust these column names if they differ in filtered_mahal_anno
            c(Gene, operon, Product, COG, COG_def, COG_cat, KEGG_Module, KEGG_module_def),
            ~ grepl(search_term, tolower(as.character(.x)), fixed = TRUE)
          )) > 0
        )
    } else {
      # If nothing is searched, default everything to a match (normal coloring)
      data <- data %>% mutate(is_match = TRUE)
    }
    
    data
  })
  
  # Text indicator for how many genes match the search term
  output$match_count <- renderText({
    df <- processed_data()
    if (!nzchar(input$text_search)) return("")
    match_num <- sum(df$is_match)
    paste0("Found ", match_num, " matching genes.")
  })
  
  # 2. Render the Highlighted Scatter Plot (Color-coded by cluster)
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    # Base plot structure using your LFC dimensions
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = model_LFC_06h, y = model_LFC_24h)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80")
    
    # Plotting logic depends on whether user is searching
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      p <- p + 
        # Background: Non-matching genes faded out completely
        geom_point(data = filter(df, !is_match), color = "grey85", alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
        # Foreground: Matching genes brightly colored by CLUSTER
        geom_point(data = filter(df, is_match), aes(color = as.factor(cluster)), alpha = 0.9, size = 3) +
        scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    } else {
      # Default view when no text is being searched: Colored by CLUSTER
      p <- p + 
        geom_point(aes(color = as.factor(cluster)), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
        scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    }
    
    p + theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = "Log2 Fold Change Coordinates (Mahal Anno)",
        x = "Log2 Fold Change (06h)",
        y = "Log2 Fold Change (24h)",
        color = "Cluster Assignment"
      ) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  })
  
  # 3. Dynamic Interactive Table
  output$metadata_table <- renderDT({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    # If a text search is active, the table immediately narrows down to just matches
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      df <- df %>% filter(is_match)
    }
    
    # If a click-and-drag box is drawn, subset the rows further by plot coordinates
    coords <- input$plot_brush
    if (!is.null(coords)) {
      df <- brushedPoints(df, coords, xvar = "model_LFC_06h", yvar = "model_LFC_24h")
    }
    
    # Organize columns for final view
    display_df <- df %>%
      select(
        Gene, cluster, model_LFC_06h, model_LFC_24h, 
        everything() # Keeps remaining metadata columns intact
      )
    
    datatable(
      display_df,
      options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE),
      rownames = FALSE
    )
  })
}

# --- Launch ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinythemes)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

# ==========================================
# DEFINITION OF TIERED BIOLOGICAL PATHWAY REGEX
# ==========================================
filter_taxonomy <- list(
  "Central Carbon (TCA/Pyruvate)" = "pyruvate|citrate|succinate|malate|fumarate|oxaloacetate|dehydrogenase|isocitrate|tca cycle|aconitase",
  "CHCA & Aromatic Engine"         = "aldolase|hpch|hpai|icmf|mutase|cyclohexane|chca|degradation|benzoate|bena|catechol|cata|catb|muconate|carboxymuconate|protocatechuate|pca|hydroxybenzoate|dioxygenase|ketoadipate|pcad|pcai|pcaj|catc|catd|oxoadipate",
  "Pimelyl-CoA & Biotin Shunt"     = "biotin|pimelate|pimelyl|bioa|biob|bioc|bioh|biod|biow|biotin synthase|oxononanoate",
  "Aliphatic/Fatty Acid Eating"    = "alkane|alkb|rubredoxin|hydroxylase|fatty acid degradation|fad|enoyl-coa",
  "PAH & Complex Hydrocarbons"     = "naphthalene|salicylate|sal|nah|toluene|xyl|benzene|styrene|ferredoxin",
  "BCAA & Lipid Remodeling"        = "fab|acpp|leucine|isoleucine|valine|branched-chain|acyl-coa|thioesterase|plsy|carboxylase",
  "Xenobiotic Resistance & Wall"   = "multidrug|resistance-nodulation-division|rnd|mara|mex|acr|beta-lactamase|bacitracin|vancomycin|tetracycline|aminoglycoside|penicillin-binding|peptidoglycan",
  "Transporters & Permeases"       = "efflux|transporter|abc transporter|permease|secy|tata|porin|facilitator",
  "Transcriptional Regulators"     = "paax|badr|regulator|repressor|two-component|sensor kinase|response regulator|marr|tetr|lysr",
  "Stress Proteomics (Heat/ROS)"   = "heat shock|groel|groes|dnak|dnaj|clp|chaperone|catalase|peroxidase|superoxide|thioredoxin|glutathione",
  "Translational Epigenetics"      = "pseudouridine|methyltransferase|wobble|miaa|trua|editing|rsoa|rsfa|silencing factor|aminoacyl-trna"
)

growth_artifacts_regex <- "initiation factor|elongation factor|if-1|if-2|ef-tu|ef-g|ef-ts|synthetase|ligase|ribosomal|alanine|trna-ala"

# ==========================================
# TOTAL RESET SANITIZATION BLOCK
# ==========================================
# 1. Force a standard data frame structure first
raw_df <- as.data.frame(filtered_mahal_anno)

# 2. Rebuild every column into a 100% flat, primitive base R vector
clean_list <- lapply(raw_df, function(col) {
  # If it's a factor, convert to character string first
  if (is.factor(col)) {
    col <- as.character(col)
  }
  # Violently wipe out all names, custom attributes, and package metadata classes
  attributes(col) <- NULL
  return(col)
})

# 3. Assemble the completely clean vectors back into an untainted dataframe
clean_mahal_anno <- data.frame(clean_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)


# --- UI Layout ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = shinytheme("cosmo"), 
  titlePanel("Interactive Gene Exploration: Cluster Analysis & Functional Pathways"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      helpText(strong("Instructions:")),
      helpText("1. Use the dropdown to immediately isolate specific biological pathways."),
      helpText("2. Check the mask option to strip away growth-confounded noise."),
      helpText("3. Type keywords to pinpoint specific elements, or highlight points via click-and-drag box (brush)."),
      hr(),
      
      # 1. Biological Taxonomy Filter Dropdown
      selectInput("pathway_filter", "Select Functional Layer:",
                  choices = c("All Functional Classes", names(filter_taxonomy))),
      
      # 2. Confounding Variable Mask Checkbox
      checkboxInput("hide_artifacts", "Mask Growth/Ribosomal Artifacts", value = TRUE),
      helpText("Clears out the massive, growth-rate confounded elongation/initiation factor cloud."),
      hr(),
      
      # Quick filter by cluster selection dropdown
      selectInput("filter_cluster", "Quick Filter by Cluster:", 
                  choices = c("All", sort(unique(as.character(clean_mahal_anno$cluster))))),
      hr(),
      
      # Text Search Box
      textInput("text_search", "Search Metadata (Case-Insensitive):", value = ""),
      span(textOutput("match_count"), style = "font-weight: bold; color: #2c3e50;")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      plotOutput("scatter_plot", brush = brushOpts(id = "plot_brush", resetOnNew = FALSE)),
      br(),
      h4("Selected/Highlighted Genes Functional Annotations"),
      DTOutput("metadata_table")
    )
  )
)


# --- Server Logic ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # 1. Reactive dataset handling text searching, cluster filters, and pathway regex layers
  processed_data <- reactive({
    data <- clean_mahal_anno
    
    meta_cols <- c(
      "Gene", "operon", "Product", "is_driver",
      "COG", "COG_def", "COG_cat", "COG_cat_def", 
      "KO", "KO_def", "cant-hyd", 
      "KEGG_Module", "KEGG_module_def", "KEGG_Pathway", "KEGG_path_def", "KEGG_Reaction", "KEGG_rclass"
    )
    meta_cols <- intersect(meta_cols, colnames(data))
    
    # A. Apply Growth Confounding Mask if selected (FIXED: across -> if_any)
    if (input$hide_artifacts) {
      data <- data %>%
        filter(!if_any(any_of(meta_cols), ~ grepl(growth_artifacts_regex, as.character(.x), ignore.case = TRUE)))
    }
    
    # B. Apply Standard Cluster Dropdown Filter
    if (input$filter_cluster != "All") {
      data <- data %>% filter(cluster == input$filter_cluster)
    }
    
    # C. Apply Pathway Layer Selection Regex across all annotation vectors
    if (input$pathway_filter != "All Functional Classes") {
      pathway_regex <- filter_taxonomy[[input$pathway_filter]]
      data <- data %>%
        filter(rowSums(across(any_of(meta_cols), ~ grepl(pathway_regex, as.character(.x), ignore.case = TRUE))) > 0)
    }
    
    # D. Apply Manual Text Search Highlighting across all metadata vectors
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      search_term <- tolower(input$text_search)
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          is_match = rowSums(across(
            any_of(meta_cols),
            ~ grepl(search_term, tolower(as.character(.x)), fixed = TRUE)
          )) > 0
        )
    } else {
      data <- data %>% mutate(is_match = TRUE)
    }
    
    data
  })
  
  # Text indicator showing specific match hits
  output$match_count <- renderText({
    df <- processed_data()
    if (!nzchar(input$text_search)) return("")
    match_num <- sum(df$is_match)
    paste0("Found ", match_num, " matching genes.")
  })
  
# 2. Render the Highlighted Scatter Plot (Color-coded by cluster)
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = model_LFC_06h, y = model_LFC_24h)) +
      # Subdued background grid lines for secondary thresholds
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey85") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey85") +
      # Bold, black central axes to clearly define the 4 quadrants
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)
    
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      p <- p + 
        geom_point(data = filter(df, !is_match), color = "grey85", alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
        geom_point(data = filter(df, is_match), aes(color = as.factor(cluster)), alpha = 0.9, size = 3) +
        scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    } else {
      p <- p + 
        geom_point(aes(color = as.factor(cluster)), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
        scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    }
    
    p + theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Transcriptional Coordination Matrix:", input$pathway_filter),
        x = "Log2 Fold Change (06h Acute Kinetic Phase)",
        y = "Log2 Fold Change (24h Chronic Steady-State)",
        color = "Cluster Assignment"
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50")
      )
  })
  
  # 3. Dynamic Interactive Table
  output$metadata_table <- renderDT({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      df <- df %>% filter(is_match)
    }
    
    coords <- input$plot_brush
    if (!is.null(coords)) {
      df <- brushedPoints(df, coords, xvar = "model_LFC_06h", yvar = "model_LFC_24h")
    }
    
    # Safely strip our transient logical query flag
    display_df <- df %>% select(-any_of("is_match"))
    
    # Organize column structure neatly for the viewer
    primary_cols <- intersect(c("Gene", "cluster", "model_LFC_06h", "model_LFC_24h", "Product", "membership_score"), colnames(display_df))
    extra_cols   = setdiff(colnames(display_df), primary_cols)
    display_df   <- display_df %>% select(all_of(primary_cols), all_of(extra_cols))
    
    # EMERGENCY FAILSALFE: Explicitly force every column to be a simple primitive vector 
    # This prevents complex data types from reaching JSON serialization
    display_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(display_df, function(x) {
      if (is.list(x)) return(sapply(x, toString))
      return(x)
    }), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    datatable(
      display_df,
      options = list(
        pageLength = 5, 
        scrollX = TRUE,
        searchHighlight = TRUE
      ),
      rownames = FALSE,
      filter = "top"
    ) %>%
      formatRound(columns = intersect(c("model_LFC_06h", "model_LFC_24h", "membership_score", "mahalanobis_dist"), colnames(display_df)), digits = 2)
  })
}

# --- Launch Engine ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
filter_taxonomy <- list(

  "Pimelyl-CoA & Biotin Shunt"     = "biotin|pimelate|pimelyl|bioa|biob|bioc|bioh|biod|biow|biotin synthase|oxononanoate|bioy|bioi",
  "Aliphatic/Fatty Acid Eating"    = "alkane|alkb|rubredoxin|hydroxylase|fatty acid degradation|fad|enoyl-coa",
  "PAH & Complex Hydrocarbons"     = "naphthalene|salicylate|sal|nah|toluene|xyl|benzene|styrene|ferredoxin",

"Cyclic Amino Acids & Osmoprotection" = "\\bproline\\b|\\bhydroxyproline\\b|\\bputA\\b|\\bputP\\b|\\bproA\\b|\\bproB\\b|\\bproC\\b|\\bproV\\b|\\bproW\\b|\\bproX\\b|\\bshikimate\\b|\\bchorismate\\b|\\bprephenate\\b|\\bphenylalanine\\b|\\btyrosine\\b|\\btryptophan\\b|\\baroG\\b|\\baroF\\b|\\baroH\\b|\\bopuu\\b",

  "Membrane Fluidity & Adaptation" = "desaturase|desA|des|fatty acid desaturase|cls|cardiolipin synthase|lipid bilayer stability",
  "Gram-Pos Cell Wall & Envelope"  = "mprf|dltA|dltB|dltC|dltD|liaR|liaS|peptidoglycan|teichoic acid|penicillin-binding|cell wall stress|bacitracin|vancomycin",

  "Translational Epigenetics"      = "pseudouridine|methyltransferase|wobble|miaa|trua|editing|rsoa|rsfa|silencing factor|aminoacyl-trna"
)

growth_artifacts_regex <- "initiation factor|elongation factor|if-1|if-2|ef-tu|ef-g|ef-ts|synthetase|ligase|ribosomal|alanine|trna-ala"

# ==========================================
# TOTAL RESET SANITIZATION BLOCK
# ==========================================
# 1. Force a standard data frame structure first
raw_df <- as.data.frame(filtered_mahal_anno)

# 2. Rebuild every column into a 100% flat, primitive base R vector
clean_list <- lapply(raw_df, function(col) {
  # If it's a factor, convert to character string first
  if (is.factor(col)) {
    col <- as.character(col)
  }
  # Violently wipe out all names, custom attributes, and package metadata classes
  attributes(col) <- NULL
  return(col)
})

# 3. Assemble the completely clean vectors back into an untainted dataframe
clean_mahal_anno <- data.frame(clean_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)


# --- UI Layout ---
ui <- fluidPage(

    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,

      br(),
      h4("Selected/Highlighted Genes Functional Annotations"),

    )
  )
)


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # 1. Reactive dataset handling text searching, cluster filters, and pathway regex layers
  processed_data <- reactive({
    data <- clean_mahal_anno
    
    meta_cols <- c(
      "Gene", "operon", "Product", "is_driver",
      "COG", "COG_def", "COG_cat", "COG_cat_def", 
      "KO", "KO_def", "cant-hyd", 
      "KEGG_Module", "KEGG_module_def", "KEGG_Pathway", "KEGG_path_def", "KEGG_Reaction", "KEGG_rclass"
    )
    meta_cols <- intersect(meta_cols, colnames(data))
    
    # A. Apply Growth Confounding Mask if selected
    if (input$hide_artifacts) {
      data <- data %>%
        filter(!if_any(any_of(meta_cols), ~ grepl(growth_artifacts_regex, as.character(.x), ignore.case = TRUE)))
    }
    
    # B. Apply Standard Cluster Dropdown Filter
    if (input$filter_cluster != "All") {
      data <- data %>% filter(cluster == input$filter_cluster)
    }
    
    # C. NEW: Evaluate Pathway Layer Selection Regex without discarding non-matches
    if (input$pathway_filter != "All Functional Classes") {
      pathway_regex <- filter_taxonomy[[input$pathway_filter]]
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          is_pathway_match = rowSums(across(any_of(meta_cols), ~ grepl(pathway_regex, as.character(.x), ignore.case = TRUE))) > 0
        )
    } else {
      data <- data %>% mutate(is_pathway_match = TRUE)
    }
    
    # D. Apply Manual Text Search Highlighting across all metadata vectors
    if (nzchar(input$text_search)) {
      search_term <- tolower(input$text_search)
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          is_match = rowSums(across(
            any_of(meta_cols),
            ~ grepl(search_term, tolower(as.character(.x)), fixed = TRUE)
          )) > 0
        )
    } else {
      data <- data %>% mutate(is_match = TRUE)
    }
    
    data
  })
  
  # Text indicator showing specific match hits (counting active dropdown + text matches)
  output$match_count <- renderText({
    df <- processed_data()
    if (!nzchar(input$text_search)) return("")
    match_num <- sum(df$is_match & df$is_pathway_match)
    paste0("Found ", match_num, " matching genes.")
  })
  
  # 2. Render the Highlighted Scatter Plot (with background gene cloud)
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    # Split the data into background cloud and foreground points
    bg_cloud   <- filter(df, !is_pathway_match | !is_match)
    fg_visible <- filter(df, is_pathway_match & is_match)
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = model_LFC_06h, y = model_LFC_24h)) +
      # Secondary threshold lines
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey85") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey85") +
      # Bold black quadrant crosshairs
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      
      # LAYER 1: The background gene cloud (very light grey, smaller size)
      geom_point(data = bg_cloud, color = "grey92", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
      
      # LAYER 2: The foreground highlighted points (color-coded by cluster)
      geom_point(data = fg_visible, aes(color = as.factor(cluster)), alpha = 0.9, size = 2.5) +
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    
    p + theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Transcriptional Coordination Matrix:", input$pathway_filter),
        x = "Log2 Fold Change (06h Acute Kinetic Phase)",
        y = "Log2 Fold Change (24h Chronic Steady-State)",
        color = "Cluster Assignment"
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50")
      )
  })
  
  # 3. Dynamic Interactive Table
  output$metadata_table <- renderDT({
    df <- processed_data()
    
    # Table only displays the fully matching foreground items
    df <- df %>% filter(is_pathway_match & is_match)
    
    coords <- input$plot_brush
    if (!is.null(coords)) {
      df <- brushedPoints(df, coords, xvar = "model_LFC_06h", yvar = "model_LFC_24h")
    }
    
    # Safely strip our transient logical query flags
    display_df <- df %>% select(-any_of(c("is_match", "is_pathway_match")))
    
    # Organize column structure neatly for the viewer
    primary_cols <- intersect(c("Gene", "cluster", "model_LFC_06h", "model_LFC_24h", "Product", "membership_score"), colnames(display_df))
    extra_cols   = setdiff(colnames(display_df), primary_cols)
    display_df   <- display_df %>% select(all_of(primary_cols), all_of(extra_cols))
    
    # EMERGENCY FAILSAFE: Explicitly force every column to be a simple primitive vector
    display_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(display_df, function(x) {
      if (is.list(x)) return(sapply(x, toString))
      return(x)
    }), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    datatable(
      display_df,
      options = list(
        pageLength = 5, 
        scrollX = TRUE,
        searchHighlight = TRUE
      ),
      rownames = FALSE,
      filter = "top"
    ) %>%
      formatRound(columns = intersect(c("model_LFC_06h", "model_LFC_24h", "membership_score", "mahalanobis_dist"), colnames(display_df)), digits = 2)
  })
}

# --- Launch Engine ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
